candidates.researchQuestion: When a security-sensitive runtime component becomes authoritative for credential-provider state, how should a layered configuration system prevent a lower-trust project layer from regaining control through ordinary precedence rules?
candidates.title: Precedence Is Not Configuration Authority
candidates.coreProposition: Security-sensitive layered configuration must model authority ownership separately from value precedence: when an effective policy gives a credential broker control of provider and startup inputs, lower-trust project configuration should lose that decision surface rather than merely lose a value comparison.

sections.heading: A winning value can still leave the wrong participant in the room
sections.heading_zh: 获胜的值，也可能让错误的参与者留在场内

sections.heading: Effective state turns ownership into an executable rule
sections.heading_zh: Effective State 把 Ownership 变成可执行规则

sections.heading: An authority boundary creates maintenance and audit obligations
sections.heading_zh: Authority Boundary 同时带来维护与审计义务

sections.heading: A narrow boundary is not universal credential isolation
sections.heading_zh: 有界边界不是通用 Credential Isolation

evidenceClaims.claim: The merged Codex change distinguishes unconfigured, disabled and enabled credential-broker states and hardens the project layer only when brokering is effectively enabled.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 已合并 Codex 变更区分 Unconfigured、Disabled 与 Enabled Broker State，并只在 Brokering 实际启用时强化项目层。

evidenceClaims.claim: The enabled branch removes project shell snapshot/profile controls and protected provider/startup environment keys.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Enabled Branch 会移除项目 Shell Snapshot/Profile 控制与受保护 Provider/Startup 环境键。

evidenceClaims.claim: The disabled branch preserves ordinary project shell configuration.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Disabled Branch 保留普通项目 Shell Configuration。

evidenceClaims.claim: Security-sensitive ownership must remove unauthorized participation rather than merely rank competing values.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 安全敏感 Ownership 必须移除未授权参与，而不是只排列竞争值。

evidenceClaims.claim: The demonstrated project boundary does not prove universal credential isolation.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 已证明项目边界不能推出通用 Credential Isolation。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns general layered-configuration authority.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already provides the transferable pattern; a separate community edition would repeat the same evidence.

candidates.researchQuestion: When a resumable agent cannot know whether a durable Session append committed before an interruption, what state must be resolved before the runtime is allowed to continue model execution?
candidates.title: A Checkpoint Is Not Permission to Resume
candidates.title_zh: 有检查点，不等于可以继续执行
candidates.coreProposition: Uncertain persistence is a first-class recovery state that must suspend continuation authority: persist the unresolved intent, reread authoritative history, classify committed, absent or ambiguous state, and fail closed on ambiguity before any new model execution.

sections.heading: Resumability preserves state, not certainty
sections.heading_zh: Resumability 保存状态，不保存确定性

sections.heading: Reconciliation is the gate before new reasoning
sections.heading_zh: Reconciliation 是新 Reasoning 之前的门禁

sections.heading: Recovery evidence and execution progress are different records
sections.heading_zh: Recovery Evidence 与 Execution Progress 是不同记录

sections.heading: Session reconciliation does not make external effects transactional
sections.heading_zh: Session Reconciliation 不会让 External Effect 具有事务性

evidenceClaims.claim: The Agents SDK persists a pending Session write with identity, item batch, pre-write fingerprint and item count.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Agents SDK 持久化带 Identity、Item Batch、Pre-write Fingerprint 与 Item Count 的 Pending Session Write。

evidenceClaims.claim: Streaming and non-streaming resume reconcile pending persistence before the next model call.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Streaming 与 Non-streaming Resume 都在下一次 Model Call 前处理 Pending Persistence。

evidenceClaims.claim: Exact fingerprints distinguish already committed, unchanged and ambiguous history outcomes.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 精确 Fingerprint 区分 Already Committed、Unchanged 与 Ambiguous History Outcome。

evidenceClaims.claim: The implementation has no distributed compare-and-swap and its guard is process-local.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 实现没有分布式 Compare-and-swap，Guard 只在进程内有效。

evidenceClaims.claim: Uncertain persistence should withhold continuation authority until authoritative storage classifies the effect.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Uncertain Persistence 应在权威 Storage 完成 Effect 分类前暂停 Continuation Authority。

evidenceClaims.claim: Bounded replay protection does not create distributed exactly-once semantics.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 有界 Replay Protection 不会产生分布式 Exactly-once Semantics。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns general resumable-runtime persistence.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already provides the transferable pattern; a separate community edition would repeat the same evidence.

candidates.researchQuestion: When a mutable runtime resource can move or change between discovery and lock acquisition, which observations remain trustworthy once the migration actually obtains authority to act?
candidates.title: Finding a Resource Is Not Owning It
candidates.title_zh: 找到资源，不等于拥有资源
candidates.coreProposition: For mutable runtime resources, discovery is provisional evidence rather than execution authority: after writer ownership is acquired and before mutation, revalidate logical identity, current location and decision-relevant state, while keeping busy contention distinct from terminal failure.

sections.heading: A path is a locator, not a durable identity
sections.heading_zh: Path 是 Locator，不是 Durable Identity

sections.heading: Authority changes which observations can justify mutation
sections.heading_zh: Authority 改变哪些 Observation 足以支持 Mutation

sections.heading: Busy and failed are different lifecycle facts
sections.heading_zh: Busy 与 Failed 是不同 Lifecycle Fact

sections.heading: Local recovery is not a distributed migration protocol
sections.heading_zh: Local Recovery 不是 Distributed Migration Protocol

evidenceClaims.claim: The Codex migration can rediscover rollout paths instead of binding execution to the first locator.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Codex Migration 可以重新发现 Rollout Path，而不是把 Execution 绑定到第一个 Locator。

evidenceClaims.claim: Apparently empty rollouts are reread while holding the writer lock.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 看似为空的 Rollout 会在持有 Writer Lock 时重新读取。

evidenceClaims.claim: Path movement between metadata read and lock acquisition triggers post-lock rediscovery.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Metadata Read 与 Lock Acquisition 之间发生 Path Movement 时会触发 Post-lock Rediscovery。

evidenceClaims.claim: Writer contention remains busy and retryable while terminal failure is tracked separately.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Writer Contention 保持 Busy 与可重试，Terminal Failure 单独跟踪。

evidenceClaims.claim: Pre-lock discovery is provisional evidence and must be revalidated after authority acquisition.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Pre-lock Discovery 是临时证据，必须在取得 Authority 后重新核验。

evidenceClaims.claim: Local revalidation does not establish distributed locking or exactly-once migration.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Local Revalidation 不能建立 Distributed Locking 或 Exactly-once Migration。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns general mutable-resource concurrency.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already provides the transferable pattern; a separate community edition would repeat the same evidence.
